note: LEADS.md Part N (ovg-project/kvcached, Apache-2.0), leads N1 and N2: the elastic K/V of kvcached already exists in this engine as --kv-grow (src/core/vmm.cpp, hipMemAddressReserve / hipMemCreate / hipMemMap / hipMemSetAccess), but the daily preset carries --kv-resident 32768 and the engine leaves --kv-grow OFF under it (generate.cpp: o.kv_resident <= 0), so specs 31 / 31c (T-390, T-391) measured the base twice (tools/pancake/spec_lint.py INERT-GATE). This spec is the first run in which the switch can act: the arms remove --kv-resident (whole K/V in VRAM at --max-context 131072: 131072 cells x 1056 B x 12 QSA layers = 1.55 GiB int8, against 0.39 GiB for the 32768 ring) and then turn --kv-grow on. whole-kv is the control (the expert cache shrinks by the whole-K/V difference, no growth), kvgrow-whole maps the K/V in steps of 8192 cells from 16384 cells and lends the unmapped chunks to the expert cache, kvgrow-whole-init8k starts from 8192 cells, kvgrow-whole-zeroback adds STRATA_VMM_ZERO_BACK=1 (kvcached's zero-page backing: every unmapped chunk of the K/V and cache ranges is mapped read-only to one shared zero chunk; robustness, expected speed 0). Exact (placement only, text must equal base). CHECK FIRST on every kvgrow arm: the engine stderr must hold 'strata generate: elastic K/V: N of 131072 cells in VRAM' and must NOT hold '--kv-grow is off' (the new line says which condition failed); an arm without the first line is the base. Also read 'expert cache auto: N slots' per arm: the expected gain is slots, and the whole bound is the ring (0.39 GiB = about 290 slots of 1.37 MiB, 2.7% of 10909), so a result above 1% end to end would be a surprise; the earlier kv8k lending gave +5% slots and no decode change (T-273). First, once, on the box: tools/pancake/vmm_probe (hipcc, see its header) to see that hipMemCreate / hipMemMap work on gfx1100 under the box's ROCm. This is the SCREEN spec; the confirm is spec 166-kvgrow-whole-confirm.json (run it only for an arm that screens at 0% or better with none below -3%). Run: python3 tools/pancake/abtest.py bench/specs/165-kvgrow-whole-kv.json --tier screen --out bench/results/<day>-kvgrow-whole.jsonl. NOT RUN.
